quality_scope: The checkpoint's original eight-prompt quantization screen measured loss against BF16. The optimization separately passed a bounded seven-pair screen against the identical balanced checkpoint; no arbitrary-prompt quality-equivalence claim.

Separate matched qualification against v1.0.0: 168.228 to 165.953 seconds warm HTTP median, 1.35% lower, n=3 per path, fixed 2048/40/CFG1 seed-42 neon workload. These are separate experiments.

precision_profiles.exact: Every step bit-exact against the pinned BF16 framework arithmetic (the v1.0.1 contract with the exact native attention and fused normalization).

precision_profiles.schedule_fp8: The schedule with bit-exact fp8 weights and fp8 per-row activations (slower GEMMs; 44.6 dB).
